title: Content Item – Paper Support (Schema Fragment)
description: Reusable schema fragment defining content item fields specific to paper-based physical support (facsimile). Intended to be composed with other content item schema parts.

page_nb_is.title: Page numbers
page_nb_is.description: Page numbers on which the content item appears.

page_id_ss.title: Page identifiers
page_id_ss.description: Identifiers of the pages on which the content item appears.

nb_pages_i.title: Number of pages
nb_pages_i.description: Total number of distinct pages the content item spans.

front_b.title: Appears on front page
front_b.description: Indicates whether the content item appears on the front page of the issue.

cc_b.title: Converted Coordinates (legacy)
cc_b.description: Whether the content item has reliable coordinate information

reading_order_i.title: Reading order
reading_order_i.description: Reading order position of the content item within the issue.

olr_b.description: Whether the page where the CI originates has been processed with OLR or not.

rc_plains.description: Region coordinates (rc) in plain text format with page and coordinate information

lb_plain.description: Line boundaries (lb) in plain text format

pb_plain.description: Paragraph boundaries (pb) in plain text format

rb_plain.description: Region boundaries (rb) in plain text format
